name: Oona
aliases: queen and mother of all faeries
description: Oona was the ancient queen of the faeries of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, creator of Maralen and Oko, whose meddling caused the plane's transformation.

description_citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Oona was the ancient queen of the faeries of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, creator of Maralen and Oko, whose meddling caused the plane's transformation.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: All faeries came from Oona, and they gathered secrets and dreamstuff to empower her.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Oko was her first attempt at an heir and first avatar, who rebelled and left the plane after he sparked.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

bio.text: She made Maralen as a duplicate avatar and gave her a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Oona's meddling left the plane's aspects bleeding into one another, and after the Great Aurora turned the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeated her.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.
"Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Maralen, who defied her maker, is said to have ultimately killed her.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

bio.text: Her downfall let Eirdu and Isilu emerge and gave birth to the Mass of Mysteries.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.
"The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

bio.text: Later, Maralen found petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and feared that Oona was returning, and Rhys came at her with a poisoned dagger believing she was Oona, until Oko told him otherwise.

status.text: Oona was defeated and her body destroyed, though her consciousness is said to remain hidden and recovering, and Maralen feared her return in December 2025.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated and destroyed, ending her control over the cycle of day and night, but her meddling leaves the plane's aspects bleeding into one another.
timeline.quote: the queen and mother of all faeries, Oona, had been defeated and destroyed, and her control over the cycle of day and night had ended.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Oona creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.
timeline.quote: she created a duplicate Maralen, a Mornsong elf, and instilled this duplicate with a piece of her soul

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys visits Maralen, who is reminded of the pact by which he would kill her if she followed Oona's path.
timeline.quote: Should she show any sign that her slow transformations had started to lead her down her creator's path, Rhys would kill her

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and realizes her independence may be unraveling.
timeline.quote: These were the petals of Oona's flesh, and they couldn't be here, unless—

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen sees Oona's gaze in the mirror and hears laughter.
timeline.quote: she met the terrible gaze of Oona and pushed herself away from the mirror so hard

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells the students Oona is returning and she does not know if she can stop her.
timeline.quote: Oona is returning, and this time, I don't know if I can stop her.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen finds a hidden coracle and the trio drifts toward the Wanderwine; Maralen explains Oona was her creator and she must prove she is not her.
timeline.quote: But I'm still myself.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen reveals she was made by Oona as a weapon-avatar and slipped into the skin of Maralen of the Mornsong.
timeline.quote: I was to be her avatar, a part of her, carrying her consciousness ahead of my own.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells of her older brother, Oona's first avatar, who defied her, befriended a giant he called father, and vanished after Oona had the giant killed.
timeline.quote: The first was my brother.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhys approaches Maralen with a poisoned dagger, calling her Oona.
timeline.quote: I made your heir a promise. I made my friend a promise. This ends now.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals that Liliana knows him as Oko and that he was Oona's first attempt at an heir.
timeline.quote: She knows me as Oko. I was Oona's first attempt at an heir.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Oko tells Rhys that Maralen is not Oona reborn and spares him, since Rhys thought he was destroying a tyrant.
timeline.quote: You thought you were destroying a tyrant, and that, at least, I can respect.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu emerge after the downfall of Oona.
timeline.quote: They emerged after the downfall of Oona

citation.work: The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Maralen, originally an avatar of Oona, becomes steward of the plane from Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: Originally an avatar of Oona, Maralen is now the steward of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor alongside Eirdu and Isilu

citation.work: The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Oko, Oona's first avatar, rebels and leaves the plane after he sparked.
timeline.quote: Oko was quick to leave the plane after he sparked and has been causing turmoil across the Multiverse ever since.

citation.work: The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Brigid and Sygg are part of the group that brought down Oona; Brigid once sailed as a pirate under Sygg.
timeline.quote: A principled member of the group responsible for Oona's downfall

citation.work: The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The Mass of Mysteries is born when Oona is struck down.
timeline.quote: a curious new entity was born—the Mass of Mysteries.

citation.work: The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed
citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Oona, queen of the faeries, causes the plane's transformation.
timeline.quote: for it was their queen, Oona, who caused it.

citation.work: Lorwyn & Shadowmoor
citation.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Maralen defied Oona and ultimately killed her.
relations.quote: Maralen defied and ultimately killed Oona to become the new queen of the fae.
